title: Pilot Procedure
description: The frontmatter of a pilot procedure (PP): predefined conduct extracted from prominent decisions and orders, opened when its trigger arrives, matching a roster with tasks, context and steps; this lets the pilot announce a procedure in place of producing a fresh decision. Filed by identifier and name, PP-001-forming-a-team.md.

type.description: the words Pilot Procedure, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this procedure's identifier, PP, a dash and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

status.description: whether the procedure is in force: draft, active or retired

trigger.description: what opens the procedure: on-demand (the pilot decides the condition has arrived), named (invoked by name) or periodical (an event makes it due)

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

approved.description: the date the commander approved the procedure, YYYY-MM-DD; absent while it is a draft

roster.description: the name of the roster this procedure dispatches, or omitted when the pilot flies it alone

context.description: the identifiers behind this procedure, a bracketed list: the decision or order it was extracted from. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them
